name: Google Pixel Buds (5-band)
notes: Pixel Buds Pro / Pixel Buds Pro 2 / Pixel Buds 2a custom EQ in the Google Pixel Buds app (bands labeled lower bass/bass/mid/treble/upper treble in the UI). Confirmed publicly: 5 adjustable bands. NOT confirmed: exact center frequencies or gain range -- Google hasn't published these. Frequencies here follow the classic 5-band graphic-EQ convention (60/230/910/3.6k/14k Hz, the same spacing used in many consumer EQs) rather than a confirmed Google source; gain range/step are a typical consumer-TWS assumption. Correct via the manual editor if you have the device and it differs.
